description: Write a soundtrack for a video from the video itself, with ElevenLabs Video to Music: it watches the cuts, pace and mood and scores them. Use it when the customer asks for music made for their video ("write a soundtrack for this", "score my clip"). When they bring their own song (for example from Suno), use that song instead and do not call this. Pass the video in video_url (the file id or name from this chat, or an https link), or video_id for a video made in Switch (its job id from list_my_videos; up to 10 videos in video_urls, all together up to 200 MB and 10 minutes). Optional: description (the music in words, up to 4100 characters), tags (up to 10 styles, like "cinematic", "lofi"), add_sound_effects (sound effect cues from the picture), use_video_sound_as_reference (its genre, tempo, instruments, mood and arc from the video's own sound), separate_tracks (the music and the effects as two files), video_seconds (the video's length, for the hold). HOUSE RULE: only make music when the customer asked for music. Billed like generate_music, per 10 seconds of the track (a token quote applies). Returns audio_url, duration_seconds and generation_id, and effects_track with separate_tracks. It does not put the music on the video: add_sound_to_video or the Editor does that.

add_sound_effects.description: Optional. true adds sound effect cues taken from the picture.

description.description: Optional. The music in plain words: genre, mood, instruments, how it builds.

model_id.description: Optional ElevenLabs model id; leave out for their default.

separate_tracks.description: Optional. true returns the music and the sound effects as two files.

use_video_sound_as_reference.description: Optional. true takes the genre, tempo, instruments, mood and arc from the video's own sound.

video_id.description: A video made in Switch, by its job id (list_my_videos, get_video_status); its stored file is used.

video_seconds.description: Optional. The video's length in seconds, so the right amount is held before it starts.

video_url.description: The video in this chat by its file id or name, or an https link.

video_urls.description: Optional, several videos scored as one, in order (up to 10).

name: video_to_music
title: Video to Music
